decisions.reason: Standalone audio and web conferencing is now a crowded, weakly differentiated layer versus our core network and infrastructure strengths, so we would reallocate effort to higher-value connectivity and cloud services.

Metropolitan data-centre interconnection is closely aligned with enterprise cloud adoption, low-latency performance needs and our owned network footprint, and it has already shown concrete market traction.
Optical spectrum connectivity directly monetises our fibre assets and supports demand for high-bandwidth, software-defined infrastructure services, making it strategically important to retain.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony product that sits poorly with the shift toward IP, cloud and integrated managed infrastructure, so it is the clearest candidate for withdrawal.
Direct voice network connection still supports enterprise communications and customer retention during voice and UC migration, even though it is a mature category with limited long-term growth.
